hud.canvasDescription: Explore five floors with the Screen Rover. Use WASD or arrow keys to drive (hold Shift to boost). Hover a glowing object (a door, the elevator pad, a board) to see its name and click it to drive there. Drag, use Q and E or the rotate buttons to turn the view; press 0 to reset it. The view turns toward displays as you approach. Rotate it yourself to override. Use the elevator, mouse wheel or PageUp and PageDown to change floors. Page view shows the portfolio as a page.

They are never used for training. No account is needed, and the only cookie is a short-lived anti-bot check. Please don't share personal information.
